answer.location_description: Small 3x3 patch near the top-left corner of the image, at rows 1-3 and columns 1-3, well away from the central blob.
answer.mechanism: Two groups of layer-1 units carry the patch. (1) The large-blob ring detectors (units 1, 3, 7, 8, 13, 24, 27, 28, plus the broadly positive units 18 and 20) have strong positive weights on the patch. (2) The small-blob / background detectors (units 11, 12, 16, 17, 19, 21, 25, 26, 29, and more weakly 31) have large positive biases, positive background weights and strongly negative weights on the patch. A bright patch therefore turns on the large-blob pathway and suppresses the small-blob pathway. In layer 2, units u0, u1, u13 and u14 receive positive input from the patch-positive units and negative input from the patch-negative units, and their output weights are positive. Unit u9 does the opposite: it is driven by units 16, 19, 21, 25 and 26 and inhibited by unit 1, and its output weight is -83. The net effect of a bright top-left patch is a higher logit, i.e. a push toward class 1.
answer.evidence: Weights on rows 1-3, columns 1-3 by unit. Positive patch: unit 1 (77, 56, 82 / 32, 33, 81 / 59, 54, 78), unit 7 (82, 45, 48 / 46, 67, 65 / 88, 57, 79), unit 8 (64-83), unit 24 (77, 75, 74 / 93, 70, 60 / 84, 68, 74), unit 28 (89, 73, 67, ...), unit 18 (up to 92), unit 20 (up to 90). Negative patch: unit 11 (-73 to -91), unit 12 (-56 to -99), unit 29 (-50 to -96), unit 26, unit 19 (-90). The same units are near zero or random on the rest of the image's border rows and columns. This is a sharply localized 3x3 block, and its sign matches each unit's large-versus-small role. Output weights: u0 +63, u1 +91, u13 +99, u14 +72, u9 -83.
answer.main_feature: Annular ring detectors (units 1, 3, 7, 8, 13, 24, 27, 28) have positive weights at radius about 4-7 px around the centre, roughly rows 5-18, so they fire when the blob extends outward. Units 11, 12, 16, 17, 19, 25, 26 and 29 are suppressed by that same ring and signal a small blob. The model compares these two groups to judge blob size.
